FAN skill build Config: …

Fires on jam-state — friction, cognitive dissonance, entanglement mid-session — and detonates a divergent fan of successor questions from the blocked node. Each branch routes through a named, exogenous framework (generated dynamically from session context), names the new dimension it opens, and exits as a question, not an answer. The recognition act — which branch is mine — stays with the person; the fan never picks. The committed branch re-enters the Flywheel mandate as a fresh seed. Divergent twin of /occam: where occam collapses many forks to the one that matters, fan explodes one jammed node into many structured escape routes. Invoke with /fan, "fan this", "I'm stuck", "I need a way out of this", "diverge from here", or any moment the session has hit a wall and refinement inside the current frame has run out of moves.
